title: Finite tame normalization over a supplied root divisor
statement: Let $i:U\to L$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ a finite group and $W\to U$ a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $R$ be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R\to L$, and $f\in R$ a nonzerodivisor with $R/(f)$ regular. Suppose $|G|$ is a unit in $R$. Assume $\beta:U\times_L\operatorname{Spec}R\cong D(f)$ commutes with the projection to $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], $H$ its canonical strict henselization coordinate-ring colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and $b:R\to H$ a map inducing its structural morphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put $g=b(f)$, $n_0=|G|$, $A=H[T]/(T^{n_0}-g)$, $N=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $q:N\to\operatorname{Spec}H$ the algebra structural morphism, and $V=D(g)\subset N$. Assume $g$ is not a unit. Suppose moreover that $N$ is locally Noetherian, and fix a regular integral scheme $D$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], an effective Cartier centre $j:D\to N$ [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] such that $z\in V$ if and only if $z\notin j(D)$ for every $z\in N$, and a point $\eta\in D$ whose closure is all of $D$. Then there are a scheme $C$, a finite morphism $a:C\to N$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] etale over $V$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], an open $O\subset N$ containing $j(\eta)$ over which $a$ is etale, and an isomorphism $\zeta:(a^{-1}V)\cong W\times_L V$ commuting with the projections to $V$. The map $V\to L$ is $V\hookrightarrow N\xrightarrow q\operatorname{Spec}H\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}b}\operatorname{Spec}R\xrightarrow\varphi L$. No divisor construction, purity or global etaleness is asserted.

proof.text: Use beta and its projection equation to identify U times_L T with T whenever the map T to Spec R lands in D(f). Construct the inverse to its second projection using the open-immersion lift and beta.inv; verify the two composites using the pullback universal property. The pasting isomorphism pullbackRightPullbackFstIso then expresses the punctured cover projection p as a base change of W.pi composed with isomorphisms. It is finite and etale.
Let a be the explicit composite p followed by V.ι and take C=a.normalization, n=a.fromNormalization. Apply strict_hensel_root_normalization_finite to this constructed relative normalization.
Apply strict_hensel_root_normalization_generic_etale to the same constructed normalization, its proved finiteness, and the supplied D,j,eta. This produces the open O and etaleness over O.

Use the existing upstream Scheme.Hom.pullbackFromNormalizationIso p V.ι and its hom_comp projection formula from ExtendOverInertia. Compose it with the inverse open-restriction pullback isomorphism to give zeta from n inverse-image V to the original punctured pullback. The projection formula proves zeta.hom composed with p equals n restricted to V. Since p is etale, its isomorphic restriction n restricted to V is etale. Package C,n,O,zeta and these proofs.

theorem GaloisCover.strict_hensel_root_tame_normalization
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselization barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictLocalizationToBase barY) :
    let H := strictHenselization barY
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ¬ IsUnit g → IsLocallyNoetherian N →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∃ (C : Scheme.{u}) (n : C ⟶ N),
        IsFinite n ∧ Etale (n ∣_ V) ∧
        ∃ (O : N.Opens), j η ∈ O ∧ Etale (n ∣_ O) ∧
        ∃ ζ : (n ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅
            pullback (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ),
          ζ.hom ≫ pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ) =
            n ∣_ V
